newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian chemical industry attacks 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Belgian chemical industry attacks 1997 budget.

text.p: The Chemical Industry Federation of Belgium on Wednesday attacked the country's 1997 budget, saying it would do nothing to improve the economic climate and would hit pharmaceutical companies.
"The Federation...deplores that the numerous taxes hitting families and companies will significantly slow the economic recovery," it said in a statement.
It noted the latest data from the Belgian National Bank showed that the level of activity and capacity use rates in the chemical industry fell in the second quarter of 1996.
The Federation said health sector reforms would weigh on the pharmaceutical industry. "The size and future of this dynamic sector is threatened more and more," it said.
